snippet.title: 33 Immortals - 1.0 Release Date Trailer (ESRB)
snippet.description:
The date is finally here!  We’re incredibly excited to announce that 33 Immortals will officially launch on June 10, 2026, on Steam and reach V1.0 on Epic Games Store and Xbox!

Get ready to join the rebellion and face the Wrath of God. Add the game to your wishlist now and stay tuned for more.

Steam Store: https://store.steampowered.com/app/958520/33_Immortals/ 
Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/p/33-immortals-9873a2 
Official Xbox page USA: https://www.xbox.com/games/33-immortals 

33 Immortals is a co-op action-roguelike for 33 players. Jump straight into runs, solo or with friends. Battle hordes of monsters, defeat massive bosses, and grow stronger each run. Use in-game emotes to coordinate and combine powers with your fellow rebels, and face the Wrath of God, together.
